400.description: Missing `userName` or `externalId`. (These are the only two fields validated at runtime, despite `meta.resourceType` being typed as required — it is not enforced.)

401.description: Missing/invalid bearer token, org mismatch, IDP sync disabled for the org, key ID mismatch, or key expired (verifyIdpKeyMiddleware in auth-service).

409.description: Deviation from RFC (no standard SCIM 409 body defined) - a user with this `userName` already has an `externalId` set.
